newsitem.title: USA: Mecklenburg County, N.C., to vote on $500 mln GOs.
newsitem.headline: Mecklenburg County, N.C., to vote on $500 mln GOs.

text.p: North Carolina's Mecklenburg County Commission has set a Nov. 4 referendum on a $500 million general obligation bond issue, the Charlotte Observer said Wednesday.
Proceeds would finance school construction and renovation, jail expansion and expansion of Piedmont Community College.
The proposal would raise property taxes by about $80 a year for a $150,000 home by 2001.
The commission also approved a $942 million budget for fiscal 1998. It leaves property tax rates unchanged while raising school spending by 14 percent over this year, to $120 million.
The budget raises stormwater fees by 46 cents a month, to $3.38 for the average home.
